TEXT: It's great that the school trip went off without a hitch, but...
The next question is, just how am I going to give Ayase her souvenir?
Just calling her out would be the easiest way...
Would she really come if I did?
In fact, Ayase was blocking my phone number until just recently.
She finally decided to unblock me after I listened to her troubles on various occasions.
But, wait...
If she unblocked me...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Onii-san, please give me a call, okay?
That has to be it!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Alright, you just wait, Ayase-tan!

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: ...Yes, Aragaki speaking.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Ah, Ayase? It's me!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: She hung up?!

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: ...Yes?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Don't just hang up on me like that!

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Did you need something?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Of course!

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: ...I see. Actually, there's something I wanted to talk to you about, Onii-san.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Oh? Great timing then.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: ...Yes.
Ayase didn't sound too enthusiastic.
Could she be worrying about something again?
Or could it be...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: A-Are you having some kind of weird fantasies now?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Just for the record, it's not like I'm going to confess to you or anything, Onii-san.
...She's telling me off before I've even opened my mouth.
Well, this time I'm just naturally concerned about Ayase, but...
Regardless of how many events we've had, she's the kind of heroine whose affection level just won't rise.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: ...W-Why aren't you saying anything?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Sorry. Hmm, I'm not really sure where to begin...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: ...Then it's probably nothing important, is it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Ayase, do you... hate me?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Eh...? O-Of course I do.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: ...Don't you remember... what you've done to me?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...That's right.
Ayase definitely hated me.
However, we've been talking more recently, so I forgot about it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Well, let me hear you out at least.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I've bought you those oil absorbing sheets you asked for in your mail.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Ah, really? Thank you very much!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Don't mention it.
Great. Seems like Ayase liked it.
I knew it'd be worth my while to get those.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: That's all I wanted to say. What did you want to talk about?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Yes, about that...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Um... I... have something that I need to discuss with you, Onii-san.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I see. Leave it to me! You can tell me anything.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Eh? ...Are you sure? You've already agreed... before I even tell you what it is.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: You might hate me, but I sure love you.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Eh?!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I'll listen to your troubles any time you want.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: N-Now you're just saying nice things again...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Y-You're planning something bad again, aren't you?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I don't know if it's bad or not, but I am planning something.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: I-I knew it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: My plan is that by listening to your troubles, I hope I can raise your impression of me at least a little bit.
...Hm, that settles it.
This girl should be completely smitten with me now.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: ...H-Hmph, you're saying such embarrassing things again...
Huh? That's weird.
Well, guess she isn't that naive.
I wouldn't be troubled over this if such superficial words would improve Ayase's view of me.
...It wasn't a lie though.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Anyway, I'll hear you out.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Yes...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Actually, I feel like Kirino's been rather cold towards me lately...
That's what I thought.
Ayase's concerns always revolve around Kirino.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Alright. Anyway, I want to give you your souvenir from Kyoto, so want to meet up somewhere?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: T-Then... at the usual park.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: That place, huh...
Whenever Ayase has something to talk about, she calls me to the nearby park.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: ...There's a police box right on the other side of that park, so it's useless to try and do something to me there, Onii-san.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Hahaha, I wouldn't.
...She sure doesn't trust me, huh.
